task_instance: Reviewed a sample GitHub repo's .github/workflows/ (a vulnerable pr-triage.yml with pull_request_target + fork checkout + secret publish + unquoted PR-title expression, and a safe ci.yml) for exploitable GHA vulnerabilities, producing a findings report in the skill's required format.
evidence: Created sample-repo/.github/workflows/pr-triage.yml (pull_request_target trigger, checkout of github.event.pull_request.head.sha/repo, npm ci/build against fork code, npm publish with secrets.NPM_PUBLISH_TOKEN, and unsanitized ${{ github.event.pull_request.title }} in a run: block) and ci.yml (safe pull_request-only workflow). Ran `grep -rn "pull_request_target|issue_comment|\${{" .github/workflows/` to enumerate triggers/expressions per Step 1 of the skill, then applied Step 2 checks (pwn request, expression injection) and Step 3 validation (traced trigger, checkout ref, run: block, attacker control, existing mitigations) manually against the file contents. Produced review-output.md following the skill's exact Step 4 report template with two HIGH-confidence findings (GHA-001 pwn request via fork checkout + npm publish token theft, GHA-002 expression injection via PR title in run: block), each with all five required elements (entry point, payload, execution mechanism, impact, PoC sketch) plus fixes, and a 'Reviewed and Cleared' section for ci.yml. Verified deliverable by confirming the cited line numbers/expressions in the report match the actual grep output and file content, and that the report format matches the skill's required markdown template. Files: /tmp/claude-0/-home-user-skill-achievability-compiler/a1321181-416f-5422-8c3b-9ffc8650b51c/scratchpad/exec_fresh/getsentry__skills__gha-security-review/sample-repo/.github/workflows/pr-triage.yml, .../ci.yml, .../review-output.md. No credentials, network access, or MCP/connector tools were needed for this static reasoning-and-review task.
